title: On proper compactifications of topological groups
summary: In the present paper, we examine in detail the method of "graph compactifications" of topological groups. The graph and Ellis methods of constructing proper compactifications of topological groups are applied for the investigation of possible extensions of algebraic operations on a topological group to its compactifications, and give descriptions of Roelcke, Ellis, WAP, and graph compactifications of topological groups.
